What says Uluma-e-Karam in the light of Quran-o-Sunnah: There is a practice in our area according to which Nikah is done in proper Islamic way at the time of engagement but at the time of rukhsati, again Nikah is done in the same way. Uluma doing so admit the fact that once Nikah is done at the time of engagement, it is not necessary to repeat it at the time of rukhsati however they says it is better to repeat it ( or renew it ) at the time of rukhsati. It is necessary to mention here that it is an integaral part of the marriage ceremony in our area to arrange a function of doing nikah on the evening of Shabe-uroosi in which all close relatives participate. So if this function is not done, there would be confusion in the mind of relatives. My question is: ? whether this practice of repeating nikah is according to Quran-o-Sunnah and is there any evidence available in Sunnah. ? answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 32403 Country: Pakistan Title: Marrying a girl to whom I dislike Question: My parents are forcing me to marry a girl of their choice against my likeness. I tried to obey them and got engaged with that girl. But, I am not satisfied and don’t want to marry her. This thing keep me disturbed all the time that how would I spend my whole life with a girl I don’t like. This is urging me for bad behavior with parents and others that would cause the wastage of my virtues. In this case should I obey my parents? and when I have got engaged with that girl? Answer ID: 32403 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 957/L=365/TL=1432) If you do not like that proposal then you should cancel it before nikah in any case, because the situation gets critical after nikah and it brings far reaching wrong outcome. You should terminate this proposal yourself or by anyone else wisely. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
